data.long_meaning: The name Entesarun is derived from the Arabic word 'Entasaruna', which means 'soft', 'tender', or 'delicate'. It is a beautiful name for a baby girl, evoking images of gentle flowers and soothing breezes. The name Entesarun carries the meaning “Soft, Tender, Delicate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Entesarun usually hope their child will grow to embody soft, tender, delicate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Entesarun is a name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic tradition. It symbolizes the gentle and nurturing qualities of Allah, and is believed to bring blessings of love, tenderness, and beauty to those who bear the name.
data.etymology: Entesarun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Soft, Tender, Delicate.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Entesarun total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
